risks.title: Global economic and geopolitical conditions
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions that economic, political and social conditions in North America, Europe, Taiwan and other countries could have a material effect. The intensity of language is high, describing potential negative effects on supply chain, costs and sales. This risk is weighted as macroeconomic and geopolitical.

risks.title: Increased competition from OEMs and online platforms
risks.score_rationale: The document details growing OEM efforts to restrict alternative parts usage and competitive pressure from online platforms. Language is strong ('increasingly', 'material adverse effect'). This risk is central to the company's business model.

risks.title: Dependence on relationships with insurers and repair shops
risks.score_rationale: The company's success strongly depends on acceptance and promotion of alternative parts by insurance companies and repair facilities. The text emphasizes that these relationships can be terminated, impacting sales. The 'Reputation' category is selected because trust and quality assurance programs are key.

risks.title: Intellectual property litigation related to parts
risks.score_rationale: OEMs use intellectual property claims to limit aftermarket parts sales. The text mentions ongoing litigation and the possibility of sales restrictions. Severity is moderate as the company takes measures (licensing, contests).

risks.title: Impact of transition to electric vehicles
risks.score_rationale: Rising electric vehicle adoption reduces demand for traditional parts (engines, transmissions) that are major revenue sources. The text characterizes this impact as potentially negative. The 'Technology' category is appropriate.

risks.title: Volatility in commodity and freight prices
risks.score_rationale: Metal prices (recycling) and component prices (manufacturing) are volatile, impacting revenues and costs. Freight costs are also mentioned as fluctuating. Language indicates significant historical volatility. Macroeconomic weighting.

risks.title: Supply chain risks (China/Taiwan)
risks.score_rationale: A significant portion of products is sourced in Asia (Taiwan, China), exposing the company to geopolitical tensions and logistics disruptions in these regions. The text explicitly mentions potential supply chain implications. Macro/geopolitical category.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the text
